lessons.goal: 核對截圖日期、適用期間與原始公告版本。

questions.evidence: [Sports chat] Alina: The pool is closed this Saturday. I saw this notice in a screenshot. Faris: Can you show the top of the notice? The image ends just above the date. Alina: The full picture says maintenance was scheduled for August.
questions.explanation: 截圖在日期上方截斷，未顯示日期。
questions.prompt: What part is missing from the cropped screenshot?

questions.evidence: [Sports chat] Alina: The pool is closed this Saturday. I saw this notice in a screenshot. Faris: Can you show the top of the notice? The image ends just above the date. Alina: The full picture says maintenance was scheduled for August.
questions.explanation: 完整圖片顯示八月的維護安排。
questions.prompt: When was the old maintenance scheduled?

questions.evidence: Faris: Our visit is in October. We need the current notice, not just the word 'Saturday.' Alina opens the pool's notice page and finds no closure for their planned date. She also checks the normal opening hours before correcting the group message.
questions.explanation: 訊息可是真實但不適用本次月份。
options: Its information concerns a different period.
The pool has no normal hours.
questions.prompt: Why isn't the genuine screenshot enough for October's plan?

questions.evidence: The old screenshot was genuine, but it described another period. Alina adds the relevant date and a link to the current notice page when sharing the correction. She learns that checking whether a message is real is only part of checking whether it applies. A true statement from an earlier month can still produce a wrong decision when its time limit has been cut away.

questions.prompt: What does Alina add to the correction?

questions.prompt: Which question must follow 'Is this message real?'

lessons.story:
[Sports chat] Alina: The pool is closed this Saturday. I saw this notice in a screenshot. Faris: Can you show the top of the notice? The image ends just above the date. Alina: The full picture says maintenance was scheduled for August.

Faris: Our visit is in October. We need the current notice, not just the word 'Saturday.' Alina opens the pool's notice page and finds no closure for their planned date. She also checks the normal opening hours before correcting the group message.

The old screenshot was genuine, but it described another period. Alina adds the relevant date and a link to the current notice page when sharing the correction. She learns that checking whether a message is real is only part of checking whether it applies. A true statement from an earlier month can still produce a wrong decision when its time limit has been cut away.
lessons.title: One Screenshot, Two Different Months
